title: Order the codebase onboarding
intro: Lesson 2's exact discipline for meeting a new codebase — put it in order.
prompt: Drag into order, first step on top.

steps.text: Get the app actually running (follow the README) — keep it up in the background
/init — let Claude scan the codebase and draft CLAUDE.md
Ask questions: overview, data flow, how chunking works, how sessions persist
Patch the memory with # (uv usage, the two DB collections and schemas)
Only now: request the first change, with @-anchored files

debrief: Run it first — a codebase you can't run is a codebase you can't verify changes against. Then /init for the draft map, exploration to test that map against reality, # to fix what's wrong or missing, and only then modification. The two steps people skip are the first and fourth: working on an app they've never launched, with a CLAUDE.md they never corrected — and both mistakes surface later as confidently wrong changes.
